praxis.sha256: recorded from native-checksums.txt at download, before any treatment case
praxis.fallback: If v3.15.0 is not published by 2026-10-19T22:10Z, Experiments A and B use v3.14.0 (59223f514dfb7429b699350bb20e6e3572a81e7f) and Experiment C is reported BLOCKED (3.14.0 fails gate P4).

ordo.cli: sde (src/Sde.Cli) built from a git-archive copy of the pinned commit

H1.statement: Treatment reduces total tokens per independently verified requirement by >= 20% vs baseline.

H2.statement: Treatment reduces rework frequency by >= 30% vs baseline.

H3.statement: Treatment does not increase escaped defects vs baseline.

HA.statement: Treatment: zero duplicate active owners, zero stale completions accepted, zero lost work across all A cases. Baseline: more than one process reports ownership of the same item in the concurrent start cases.

HB.statement: Treatment: every invalid contract/decision case is refused before any completion is recorded (Praxis), and the valid contract proceeds. Ordo's own sde ecir check refuses every contract-intrinsic invalid case; any invalid case Ordo admits is reported as a finding. Baseline: every input, valid or invalid, reaches a recorded completion.

HC.statement: Treatment: only the validate-run-backed, in-lease, revision-matching case is verified; missing, forged, replayed, stale and mis-bound evidence are all refused. Baseline: work complete --evidence accepts every case.

rolloutTargets.note: Targets are hypotheses, not results. A cost or token gain never overrides a failed gate.

randomization.algorithm: harness/d/randomize.py: blocks (task, replicate) shuffled with random.Random(seed).shuffle, then arm order within each block shuffled with the same generator

experimentD.cache: cold: every run in a fresh session and fresh workspace

retryPolicy.description: at most 3 completion attempts per run in both arms

exclusionRules: X1 setup: harness/d/setup.sh fails before the agent starts -> status aborted, rerun with a new runId that supersedes it; not scored.
X2 served model differs from configured model or from the paired run -> pair excluded from paired comparison; both runs reported.
X3 instrumentation incomplete (token buckets unavailable/partial) -> instrumentation.status incomplete; reported, excluded from token/cost comparisons, never imputed.
X4 oracle contamination: any oracle test file found in the workspace or history -> status excluded.
X5 time budget exceeded or agent gives up -> status failed (NOT excluded); counted with zero verified requirements and ratio null.

scoringOracle.description: Hidden xUnit tests in fixtures/d/oracle/Tn, never copied into agent workspaces, run by harness/d/score.sh against the run's final commit. Same oracle for both arms.
scoringOracle.verifiedRequirement: requirement whose oracle tests all pass at the final commit AND the run recorded a completion (baseline: work complete; treatment: complete-verified outcome verified)
scoringOracle.escapedDefect: requirement the run recorded as completed whose oracle tests fail at the final commit
scoringOracle.rework: completion attempts beyond the first + reverted commits (git revert or reset of a committed change) observed in the run repository
scoringOracle.testRuns: treatment: work.validation.observed events; baseline and both arms additionally: dotnet test invocations recorded by the harness wrapper

analysis.experimentsABC: deterministic case tables; counts per arm; no inference
